text: The legal document agent's pack tool call is treated as one read per case answered by GET /api/recovery/document/v1/cases/{caseId}/document-checklist, whose answer satisfies the agent contract with itemCode, required, present and the document IDs per item, and a 503 of that read is treated by the agent as run status TOOL_UNAVAILABLE with fallback true and the case listed as not run.
why: RWB-P10-E2030-CON is the only consumed contract and DP-11 needs a published shape with a fake; the operation and its field names are named nowhere in the sources.
read: Architecture v5 slides 10, 15, 16 and 42; FSD P5 A2.16; TSD P5 T-A.2 API-P5-008; legacy RWB-E2-030 sections 4, 7 and 12
impact: A changed tool call changes the fake and the answer mapper inside PackEvidenceAnswerer, not the stored rows.

text: The checklist version in force of a case is resolved from the stage and route the reference-data route reports for that case, the 9 litigation items of legacy case type MORTGAGE_CIVIL are held as rows of a checklist version in the story's fixtures, and no case-type key is added to document_checklist_item by this slice.
why: The hub checklist is keyed by stage_code and route_code only, so a case-type lookup cannot be built, and the story cannot invent a mapping or a set of items.
read: TSD P5 T3.1 document_checklist_item and T3.2 LOV-STAGE and LOV-ROUTE; FSD P5 A2.16; legacy RWB-E2-030 Background and AC1
impact: If a case-type key is confirmed, ChecklistVersionResolver gains one lookup and the answer gains one field; no table of another service is touched either way.

text: The document checklist answer is treated as caseId, checklistVersion, complete, requiredCount, presentCount, missingTypes, checkedAt, lastEventId and items with itemCode, typeLabel, required, sortOrder, present and documents with documentId, source, docVersion, writeOnce and reviewStatus, bounded by the page size parameter.
why: The pack reader needs the document IDs per item and the completeness reference, and the API-P5-008 response is named but not described field for field in the source.
read: TSD P5 T-A.2 API-P5-008; TSD P5 T3.1 document_checklist_item, document and case_document_check; legacy RWB-E2-030 AC1
impact: A changed field list changes the answer mapper and the contract test only; nothing is stored by this story.

text: The DEFECT status of a checklist item and its reason are left to the legal document agent, and rwb-document answers the presence of documents per item and the counts of case_document_check; the hub records no defect mark in this slice.
why: case_document_check has no defect concept and no source names the evidence a defect needs, so inventing one would invent a business rule of the pack.
read: TSD P5 T3.1 case_document_check; FSD P5 A2.16; legacy RWB-E2-030 BR3, AC1 and AC5
impact: If the hub is to own the defect mark, the answer gains a status field and case_document_check gains an evidence column, both in a later slice.

text: The traceability row of REQ-DCM-011 is left with the placeholder for its BRD section and its L3 process until the next BRD version names them, and the legacy requirement REQ-S4-002 keeps the pack assembly, the defect list and the promotion decision with RWB-P10-E2030-APP.
why: The FSD requirement table gives the statement, the priority and the epic of REQ-DCM-011 and no BRD section or L3 process, and a citation cannot be copied from a different requirement.
read: FSD P5 requirement table and A2.16; legacy RWB-E2-030 section 18
impact: Documentation only; the literal keeps the row checkable and the citation is replaced when the BRD names the section.
